verses: Alif Laam Meem
Uss kitab (kay Allah ki kitab honey) mein koi shak nahi perhezgaron ko raah dikhaney wali hai
Jo log ghaib per eman latay hain aur namaz ko qaeem rakhtay hain aur humaray diye huye (maal) mein say kharach kertay hain
Aur jo log eman latay hain uss per jo aap ki taraf utara gaya aur jo aap say pehlay utara gaya, aur woh aakhirat per bhi yaqeen rakhtay hain
Yehi log apney rab ki taraf say hidayat per hain aur yehi log falah aur nijat paney walay hain
Kafiron ko aap ka darana, ya na darana barabar hai, yeh log eman na layen gay
Allah Taalaa ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mehar ker di hai aur unn ki aankhon per pardah hai aur unn kay liye bara azab hai
Baaz log kehtay hain kay hum Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhtay hain, lekin dar-haqeeqat woh eman walay nahi hain
Woh Allah Taalaa ko aur eman walon ko dhoka detay hain, lekin dar-asal woh khud apney aap ko dhoka dey rahey hain, magar samajhtay nahi
Unn kay dilon mein beemari thi Allah Taalaa ney unhen beemari mein mazeed barha diya aur unn kay jhoot ki wajah say unn kay liye dard-naak azab hai
Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay zamin mein fasad na kero to jawab detay hain kay hum to sirf islaah kerney walay hain
Khabardaar ho! yaqeenan yehi log fasad kerney walay hain, lekin shaoor (samajh) nahi rakhtay

Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay aur logon (yani sahaba) ki tarah tum bhi eman lao to jawab detay hain kay kiya hum aisa eman layen jaisa waqoof laye hain, khabardaar hojao! yaqeenan yehi waqoof hain, lekin jantay nahi

Aur jab eman walon say miltay hain to kehtay hain kay hum bhi eman walay hain aur jab apney baron kay pass jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum to tumharay sath hain hum to unn say sirf mazaq kertay hain
Allah Taalaa bhi unn say mazaq kerta hai aur unhen unn ki sirkashi aur behkaway mein aur barha deta hai
Yeh woh log hain jinhon ney gumrahi ko hidayat kay badlay mein khareed liya, pus na to unn ki tijarat ney unn ko faeedah phonchaya aur na yeh hidayat walay huye
Unn ki misal uss shakhs ki si hai jiss ney aag jalaee, pus aas pass ki cheezen roshni mein aaee hi thin kay Allah unn kay noor ko ley gaya aur unhen andheron mein chor diya, jo nahi dekhtay
Behray, goongay, andhay hain. Pus woh nahi lottay

Ya aasmani barsaat ki tarah jiss mein andheriyan aur garaj aur bijli ho, maut say darr ker karakay ki wajah say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein daal letay hain. Aur Allah Taalaa kafiron ko gherney wala hai

Qareeb hai kay bijli unn ki aankhen uchak ley jaye, jab unn kay liye roshni kerti hai to uss mein chaltay phirtay hain aur jab unn per andhera kerti hai to kharay hojatay hain aur agar Allah Taalaa chahaye to unn kay kanon aur aankhon ko beykaar kerdey. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa her cheez per qudrat rakhney wala hai
Aey logo! apney uss rab ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur tum say pehlay kay logon ko peda kiya, yehi tumhara bachao hai

Jiss ney tumharay liye zamin ko farash aur aasman ko chat banaya aur aasman say pani utaar ker uss say phal peda kerkay tumhen rozi di, khabardaar bawajood jannay kay Allah kay shareek muqarrar na kero

Hum ney jo kuch apney banday per utara hai uss mein agar tumhen shak ho aur tum sachay ho to uss jaisi aik surat to bana lao, tumhen ikhtiyar hai kay Allah Taalaa kay siwa apney madadgaron ko bhi bula lo
Pus agar tum ney na kiya aur tum hergiz nahi saktay to (ussay sacha maan ker) uss aag say bacho jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hain, jo kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai

Aur eman walon aur nek amal kerney walon ko unn jannaton ki khushkhabriyan do, jin neechay nehren beh rahi hain. Jab kabhi woh phalon ka rizq diye jayen gay aur hum shakal laye jayen gay to kahen gay yeh o hi hai jo hum uss say pehlay diye gaye thay aur unn kay liye biwiyan hain saaf suthri aur woh unn jannaton mein hamesha rehney walay hain

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa kissi misal kay biyan kerney say nahi sharmata, khuwah machar ki ho, ya uss say bhi halki cheez ki. Eman walay to ussay apney rab ki janib say sahih samajhtay hain aur kuffaar kehtay hain kay uss misal say Allah ney kiya murad li hai? Uss kay zariye baishtar ko gumrah kerta hai aur aksar logon ko raah raast per laata hai aur gumrah to sirf fasiqon ko hi kerta hai

Jo log Allah Taalaa kay mazboot ehad ko tor detay hain aur Allah Taalaa ney jin cheezon kay jorney ka hukum diya hai, unhen kaattay aur zamin mein fasad phelatay hain, yehi log nuksan uthaney walay hain
Tum Allah kay sath kaisay kufur kertay ho? Halankay tum murdah thay uss ney tumhen zindah kiya, phir tumhen maar dalay ga, phir zindah keray ga, phir ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Woh Allah jiss ney tumharay liye zamin ki tamam cheezon ko peda kiya, phir aasman ki taraf qasad kiya aur unn ko theek thaak saat aasman banaya aur woh her cheez ko janta hai

Aur jab teray rab ney farishton say kaha kay mein zamin mein khalifa bananey wala hun, to unhon ney kaha aisay shakhs ko kiyon peda kerta hai jo zamin mein fasad keray aur khoon bahaye? Aur hum teri tasbeeh, hamd aur pakeezgi biyan kerney walay hain. Allah Taalaa ney farmaya, jo mein janta hun tum nahi jantay
Aur Allah Taalaa ney Adam ko tamam naam sikha ker unn cheezon ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur farmaya, agar tum sachay ho to unn cheezon kay naam batao
Unn sab ney kaha aey Allah! teri zaat pak hai humen to sirf itna hi ilm hai jitna tu ney humen sikha rakha hai, pooray ilm o hikmat wala to to hi hai

Allah Taalaa ney (hazrat) Adam) alaihi as-salam (say farmaya tum unn kay naam bata do. Jab unhon ney bata diye to farmaya kay kiya mein ney tumhen (pehlay hi) na kaha tha kay zamin aur aasmano ka ghaib mein hi janta hun aur meray ilm mein hai jo tum zahir ker rahey ho aur jo tum chupatay thay
Aur jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay Adam ko sajdah kero to Iblees kay siwa sab ney sajdah kiya. Uss ney inkar kiya aur takabbur kiya aur woh kafiron mein hogaya
Aur hum ney keh diya kay aey Adam! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho aur jahan kahen say chahao ba-faraghat khao piyo, lekin uss darakht kay qareeb bhi na jana werna zalim hojao gay

Lekin shetan ney unn ko behka ker o haan say nikalwa hi diya aur hum ney keh diya kay utar jao! tum aik doosray kay dushman ho aur aik waqt muqarrar tak tumharay liye zamin mein theharna aur faeedah uthana hai
(hazrat) Adam (alaihi as-salam) ney apney rab say chand baaten seekh len aur Allah Taalaa ney unn ki tauba qabool farmaee, be-shak o hi tauba qabool kerney wala aur reham kerney wala hai
Hum ney kaha tum sab yahan say chalay jao, jab kabhi tumharay pass meri hidayat phonchay to uss ki tabeydaari kerney walon per koi khof o ghum nahi
Aur jo inkar kerkay humari aayaton ko jhutlayen, woh jahannumi hain aur hamesha ussi mein rahen gay
Aey bani israeel! meri uss nemat ko yaad kero jo mein ney tum per inam ki aur meray ehad ko poora kero mein tumharay ehad ko poora keroon ga aur mujh hi say daro

Aur uss kitab per eman lao jo mein ney tumhari kitabon ki tasdeeq mein nazil farmaee hai aur uss kay sath tum hi pehlay kafir na bano aur meri aayaton ko thori thori qeemat per na farokht kero aur sirf mujh hi say daro
Aur haq ko baatil kay sath khalat malat na kero aur na haq ko chupao, tumhen to khud uss ka ilm hai
Aur namazon ko qaeem kero aur zakat do aur rukoo kerney walon kay sath rukoo kero
Kiya logon ko bhalaiyon ka hukum kertay ho? Aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho bawajood tum kitab parhtay ho, kiya itni bhi tum mein samajh nahi?
Aur sabar aur namaz kay sath madad talab kero yeh cheez shaaq hai, magar darr rakhney walon per
Jo jantay hain kay bey shak woh apney rab say mulaqat kerney walay aur yaqeenan woh ussi ki taraf lot ker janey walay hain
Aey aulad Yaqoob! meri uss nemat ko yaad kero jo mein ney tum per inam ki aur mein ney tumhen tamam jahano per fazilat di
Uss din say dartay raho jab koi kissi ko nafa na dey sakay ga aur na hi uss ki babat koi sifarish qabool hogi aur na koi badla uss kay ewaz liya jaye ga aur na woh madad kiye jayen gay

Aur jab hum ney tumhen firaoniyon say nijat di jo tumhen bad-tareen azab detay thay jo tumharay larkon ko maar daaltay thay aur tumhari larkiyon ko chor detay thay, uss nijat denay mein tumharay rab ki bari meharbani thi
Aur jab hum ney tumharay liye darya cheer (phaar) diya aur tumhen uss say paar kerdiya aur firaoniyon ko tumhari nazron kay samney uss mein dobo diya
Aur hum ney (hazrat) Musa) alaihi as-salam (say chalees raaton ka wada kiya, phir tum ney uss kay baad bachra poojna shuroo kerdiya aur zalim bann gaye
Lekin hum ney bawajood uss kay phir bhi tumhen moaf kerdiya, takay tum shukar kero
Aur hum ney (hazrat) Musa) alaihi as-salam (ko tumhari hidayat kay liye kitab aur moajzzay ata farmaye

Jab (hazrat Musa)) alaihi as-salam (ney apni qom say kaha kay aey meri qom! bachray ko mabood bana ker tum ney apni janon per zulm kiya hai, abb tum apney peda kerney walay ki taraf rujoo kero, apney ko aapas mein qatal kero, tumhari behtri Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek ussi mein hai, to uss ney tumhari tauba qabool ki, woh tauba qabool kerney wala aur reham o karam kerney wala hai

Aur (tum ussay bhi yaad kero) tum ney (hazrat) Musa) alaihi as-salam (say kaha tha kay jab tak hum apney rab ko samney na dekh len hergiz eman na layen gay (jiss gustakhi ki saza mein) tum per tumharay dekhtay huye bijli giri
Lekin phir uss liye kay tum shukar-guzari kero, uss maut kay baad bhi hum ney tumhen zindah kerdiya

Aur hum ney tum per badal ka saya kiya aur tum per mann o salwa utara (aur keh diya) kay humari di hui pakeezah cheezen khao, aur unhon ney hum per zulm nahi kiya, albatta woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay thay

Aur hum ney tum say kaha kay uss basti mein jao aur jo kuch jahan kahen say chahao ba-faraghat khao piyo aur darwazay mein sajday kertay huye guzro aur zaban say hitta kaho hum tumhari khatayen moaf farma gay aur neki kerney walon ko aur ziyadah den gay
Phir unn zalimon ney uss baat ko jo unn say kahi gaee thi badal daali, hum ney bhi unn zalimon per unn kay fisq o na-farmani ki wajah say aasmani azab nazil kiya

Aur jab Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apni qom kay liye pani maanga to hum ney kaha kay apni laathi pathar per maaro, jiss say baara chashmay phoot niklay aur her giroh ney apna chashma pehchan liya (aur hum ney keh diya kay) Allah Taalaa ka rizq khao piyo zamin mein fasad na kertay phiro

Aur jab tum ney kaha aey Musa! hum say aik hi qasam kay khaney per hergiz sabar na hosakay ga, uss liye apney rab say dua kijiye kay woh humen zamin ki paidawaar saag, kakri, gehon, masoor aur piyaz dey, aap ney farmaya, behtar cheez kay badlay adna cheez kiyon talab kertay ho! acha shehar mein jao o haan tumhari chahat ki yeh sab cheezen milen gi. Unn per zillat aur miskeeni daal di gaee aur Allah Taalaa ka ghazab ley ker woh lotay yeh uss liye kay woh Allah Taalaa ki aayaton kay sath kufur kertay thay aur nabiyon ko na-haq qatal kertay thay, yeh unn ki farmaniyon aur ziyadtiyon ka nateeja hai

Musalman hun, yahudi hun, nasaara hun ya saabi hun, jo koi bhi Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman laye aur nek amal keray unn kay ajar unn kay rab kay pass hain aur unn per na to koi khof hai aur na udasi
Aur jab hum ney tum say wada liya aur tum per tor pahar khara kerdiya (aur kaha) jo hum ney tumhen diya hai, ussay mazbooti say thaam lo aur jo kuch uss mein hai ussay yaad kero takay tum bach sako
Lekin tum uss kay baad bhi phir gaye, phir agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tum per na hoti to tum nuksan walay hojatay
Aur yaqeenan tumhen unn logon ka ilm bhi hai jo tum mein say haftay kay baray mein hadd say barh gaye aur hum ney bhi keh diya kay tum zaleel bandar bann jao
Ussay hum ney aglon pichlon kay liye ibrat ka sabab bana diya aur perhezgaron kay liye waaz o naseehat ka

Aur (hazrat) Musa) alaihi as-salam (ney jab apni qom say kaha kay Allah Taalaa tumhen aik gaaye zibah kerney ka hukum deta hai to unhon ney kaha hum say mazaq kiyon kertay hain? Aap ney jawab diya kay mein aisa jahil honey say Allah Taalaa ki panah pakarta hun

Unhon ney kaha aey Musa! dua kijiye kay Allah Taalaa humaray liye uss ki maahiyat biyan kerdey, aap ney farmaya suno! woh gaaye na to bilkul burhiya ho, na bacha, balkay)yeh darmiyani umar ki no-jawan ho, abb jo tumhen hukum diya gaya hai baja lao

Woh phir kehney lagay kay dua kijiye kay Allah Taalaa biyan keray kay uss ka rang kiya hai? Farmaya woh kehta hai kay woh gaaye zard rang ki hai, chamkeela aur dekhney walon ko bhala lagney wala uss ka rang hai
Woh kehney lagay kay apney rab say aur dua kijiye kay humen uss ki mazeed maahiyat batlaye, uss qasam ki gaaye to boht hain pata nahi chalta, agar Allah ney chaha to hum hidayat walay hojayen gay

Aap ney farmaya kay Allah ka farman hai kay woh gaaye kaam kerney wali zamin mein hal jootney wali aur kheton ko pani pilaney wali nahi, woh tandrust aur daagh hai. Unhon ney kaha, abb aap ney haq wazeh kerdiya go woh hukum bardari kay qareeb na thay, lekin ussay mana aur woh gaaye zibah kerdi
Jab tum ney aik shakhs ko qatal ker dala, phir uss mein ikhtilaf kerney lagay aur tumhari posheedgi ko Allah Taalaa zahir kerney wala tha
Hum ney kaha kay uss gaaye ka aik tukra maqtool kay jism per laga do, (woh ji uthay ga) ussi tarah Allah mardon ko zindah kerkay tumhen tumhari aqal mandi kay liye apni nishaniyan dikhata hai

Phir uss kay baad tumharay dil pathar jaisay balkay)yeh uss say bhi ziyadah sakht hogaye, baaz pathron say to nehren beh nikalti hain, aur baaz phat jatay hain aur unn say pani nikal aata hai, aur baaz Allah Taalaa kay darr say gir gir partay hain, aur tum Allah Taalaa ko apney aemaal say ghafil na jano
(musalmano!) kiya tumhari khuwahish hai kay yeh log emandar bann jayen, halankay unn mein aisay log bhi jo kalaam Allah ko sunn ker, aqal o ilm walay hotay huye, phir bhi badal dala kertay hain

Jab eman walon say miltay hain to apni emandari zahir kertay hain aur jab aapas mein miltay hain to kehtay hain kay musalmanon ko kiyon woh baaten phonchatay ho jo Allah Taalaa ney tumhen sikhaee hain, kiya jantay nahi kay yeh to Allah Taalaa kay pass tum per unn ki hujjat hojaye gi
Kiya yeh nahi jantay kay Allah Taalaa unn ki posheedgi aur zahri sab ko janta hai?
Unn mein say baaz unn parh aisay bhi hain kay jo kitab kay sirf zahiri alfaaz ko hi jantay hain aur sirf guman aur atkal hi per hain

Unn logon kay liye "well" hai jo apney hathon ki likhi hui kitab ko Allah Taalaa ki taraf ki kehtay hain aur uss tarah duniya kamatay hain, unn kay hathon ki likhaee ko aur unn ki kamaee ko well (halakat) aur afsos hai

Yeh log kehtay hain kay hum to sirf chand roz jahannum mein rahen gay, unn say kaho kay kiya tumharay pass Allah Taalaa ka koi parwana hai? Agar hai to yaqeenan Allah Taalaa apney waday ka khilaf nahi keray ga, (hergiz nahi) balkay)yeh tum to Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagatay ho jinhen tum nahi jantay
Yaqeenan jiss ney bhi buray kaam kiye aur uss ki farmaniyon ney ussay gher liya, woh hamesha kay liye jahannumi hai
Aur jo log eman layen aur nek kaam keren woh jannati hain jo jannat mein hamesha rahen gay

Aur jab hum ney bani israeel say wada liya kay tum Allah Taalaa kay siwa doosray ki ibadat na kerna aur maa baap kay sath acha salook kerna, ussi tarah qarabat, yateemon aur miskeenon kay sath aur logon ko achi baaten kehna, namazen qaeem rakhna aur zakat detay raha kerna, lekin thoray say logon kay alawa tum sab phir gaye aur mun mor liya
Jab hum ney tum say wada liya kay aapas mein khoon na bahana (qatal na kerna) aur aapas walon ko jila watan na kerna, tum ney iqrar kiya aur tum uss kay shahid banay

Lekin phir bhi tum ney aapas mein qatal kiya aapas kay aik firqay ko jila watan bhi kiya aur gunah aur ziyadti kay kaamon mein unn kay khilaf doosray ki taraf ki, haan jab woh qaidi ho ker tumharay pass aaye to tum ney unn kay fidye diye, lekin unn ka nikalna jo tum per haram tha (uss ka kuch khayal na kiya) kiya baaz ehkaam per eman rakhtay ho aur baaz kay sath kufur kertay ho? Tum mein say jo bhi aisa keray, uss ki saza uss kay siwa kiya ho kay duniya mein ruswaee aur qayamat kay din sakht azab ki maar, aur Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal say bey-khabar nahi
Yeh woh log hain jinhon ney duniya ki zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai, unn kay na to azab halkay hun gay aur na unn ki madad ki jaye gi

Hum ney (hazrat) Musa ko kitab di aur unn kay peechay aur rasool bhejay aur hum ney (hazrat) Isa ibn Maryam ko roshan daleelen den aur rooh rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed kerwaee. Lekin jab kabhi tumharay pass rasool woh cheez laye jo tumhari tabiyaton kay khilaf thi, tum ney jhat say takabbur kiya, pus baaz ko to jhutla aur baaz ko qatal bhi ker dala
Yeh kehtay hain kay humaray dil ghilaaf walay hain nahi nahi balkay)yeh unn kay kufur ki wajah say unhen Allah Taalaa ney malaoon kerdiya hai, unn ka eman boht hi thora hai

Aur unn kay pass jab Allah Taalaa ki kitab unn ki kitab ko sacha kerney wali aaee, halankay pehlay yeh khud (uss kay zariye) kafiron per fatah chahatay thay to bawajood aajaney aur bawajood pehchan lenay kay phir kufur kerney lagay, Allah Taalaa ki laanat ho kafiron per

Boht buri hai woh cheez jiss kay badlay unhon ney apney aap ko baich dala, woh unn ka kufur kerna hai. Allah Taalaa ki taraf say nazil shuda cheez kay sath mehaz uss baat say jal ker kay Allah Taalaa ney apna fazal apney jiss bandah per chaha nazil farmaya, uss kay baees yeh log ghazab per ghazab kay mustahiq hogaye aur unn kafiron kay liye ruswa kerney wala azab hai

Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah Taalaa ki utari hui kitab per eman lao to keh detay hain kay jo hum per utari gaee uss per humara eman hai. Halankay uss kay baad wali kay sath jo unn ki kitab ki tasdeeq kerney wali hai, kufur kertay hain, acha unn say yeh to daryaft keren kay agar tumhara eman pehli kitabon per hai to phir tum ney aglay anbiya ko kiyon qatal kiya?
Tumharay pass to Musa yehi daleelen ley ker aaye lekin tum ney phir bhi bachra pooja tum ho hi zalim

Jab hum ney tum say wada liya aur tum per tor ko khara kerdiya (aur keh diya) kay humari di hui cheez ko mazboot thaamo aur suno! to unhon ney kaha, hum ney suna aur na-farmani ki aur unn kay dilon mein bachray ki mohabbat (goya) pila di gaee ba-sabab unn kay kufur kay. Unn say keh dijiye kay tumhara eman tumhen bura hukum dey raha hai, agar tum momin ho
Aap keh dijiye kay agar aakhirat ka ghar sirf tumharay hi liye hai, Allah kay nazdeek aur kissi kay liye nahi, to aao apni sachaee kay saboot mein maut talab kero
Lekin apni kartooton ko dekhtay huye kabhi bhi maut nahi maangen gay Allah Taalaa zalimon ko khoob janta hai

Balkay)yeh sab say ziyadah duniya ki zindagi ka harees aey nabi! aap unhen ko payen gay. Yeh hirss zindagi mein mushrikon say bhi ziyadah hain unn mein say to her shakhs aik aik hazar saal ki umar chahata hai, goya yeh umar diya jana bhi unhen azab say nahi chura sakta, Allah Taalaa unn kay kaamon ko bakhoobi dekh raha hai

(aey nabi!) aap keh dijiye kay jo jibraeel ka dushman ho jiss ney aap kay dil per paygham bari Taalaa utara hai, jo paygham unn kay pass ki kitab ki tasdeeq kerney wala aur mominon ko hidayat aur khushkhabri denay wala hai
(to Allah bhi uss ka dushman hai) jo shakhs Allah ka aur uss kay farishton aur uss kay rasoolon aur Jibraeel aur mikaeel ka dushman ho, aisay kafiron ka dushman khud Allah hai
Aur yaqeenan hum ney aap ki taraf roshan daleelen bheji hain jin ka inkar siwaye badkaron kay koi nahi kerta
Yeh log jab kabhi koi ehad kertay hain to unn ki aik na aik jamat ussay tor deti hai, balkay)yeh unn mein say aksar eman say khali hain
Jab kabhi unn kay pass Allah ka koi rasool unn ki kitab ki tasdeeq kerney wala aaya, unn ahl kitab kay aik firqay ney Allah ki kitab ko uss tarah peeth peechay daal diya, goya jantay hi na thay

Aur uss cheez kay peechay lag gaye jissay shayateen (hazrat) Sulaiman ki hukoomat mein parhtay thay. Sulaiman ney to kufur na kiya tha, balkay)yeh yeh kufur shetanon ka tha, woh logon ko jadoo sikhaya kertay thay, aur babul mein haroot maroot do farishton per utara gaya tha, woh dono bhi kissi shakhs ko uss waqt tak nahi sikhatay thay jab tak yeh na keh den kay hum to aik aazmaeesh hain to kufur na ker, phir log unn say woh seekhtay jiss say khawind o biwi mein judaee daal den aur dar-asal woh baghair Allah Taalaa ki marzi kay kissi ko koi nuksan nahi phoncha saktay, yeh log woh seekhtay hain jo unhen nuksan phonchaye aur nafa na phoncha sakay, aur woh bil-yaqeen jantay hain kay uss kay lenay walay ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi. Aur woh bad-tareen cheez hai jiss kay badlay woh apney aap ko farokht ker rahey hain, kaash kay yeh jantay hotay
Agar yeh log sahib-e-eman eman muttaqi bann jatay to Allah Taalaa ki taraf say behtareen sawab unhen milta, agar yeh jantay hotay
Aey eman walo! tum (nabi salla Allah alaihi wasallam ko) "raaeena" na kaha kero, balkay)yeh "un-zurna" kaho yani humari taraf dekhiye aur suntay raha kero aur kafiron kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Na to ahl kitab kay kafir aur na mushrikeen chahatay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki koi bhalaee nazil ho (unn kay uss hasad say kiya hua) Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye apni rehmat khasusiyat say ata farmaye, Allah Taalaa baray fazal wala hai
Jiss aayat ko hum mansookh ker den, ya bhala den uss say behtar ya uss jaisi aur latay hain, kiya to nahi janta kay Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Kiya tujhay ilm nahi kay zamin o aasman ka mulk Allah hi kay liye hai aur Allah kay siwa tumhara koi o li aur madadgar nahi
Kiya tum apney rasool say yehi poochna chahatay ho jo uss say pehlay Musa) alaihi as-salam (say poocha gaya tha? (suno) eman ko kufur say badalney wala seedhi raah say bhatak jata hai

Unn ahl kitab kay aksar log bawajood haq wazeh hojaney kay mehaz hasad o bughz ki bana per tumhen bhi eman say hata dena chahatay hain, tum bhi moaf kero aur choro yahan tak kay Allah Taalaa apna hukum laye. Yaqeenan Allah taalaa her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai
Tum namazen qaeem rakho aur zakat detay raha kero aur jo kuch bhalaee tum apney liye aagay bhejo gay, sab kuch Allah kay pass paalo gay, be-shak Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal ko khoob dekh raha hai
Yeh kehtay hain kay jannat mein yahud o nasaara kay siwa aur koi na jaye ga, yeh sirf unn ki aarzooyen hain, unn say kaho kay agar tum sachay ho to koi daleel to paish kero
Suno! jo bhi apney aap ko khuloos kay sath Allah kay samney jhuka dey. Be-shak ussay uss ka rab poora badla dey ga, uss per na to koi khof hoga, na ghum aur udasi

Yahud kehtay hain kay nasrani haq per nahi aur nasrani kehtay hain kay yahudi haq per nahi, halankay yeh sab log Taurat parhtay hain. Ussi tarah unn hi jaisi baat be-ilm bhi kehtay hain. Qayamat kay din Allah unn kay uss ikhtilaf ka faisla unn kay darmiyan kerdey ga

Uss shakhs say barh ker zalim kaun hai jo Allah Taalaa ki masjidon mein Allah Taalaa kay zikar kiye janey ko rokay aur unn ki barbadi ki koshish keray, aisay logon ko khof khatay huye uss mein jana chahaye, unn kay liye duniya mein bhi ruswaee hai aur aakhirat mein bhi bara azab hai
Aur mashriq aur maghrib ka malik Allah hi hai. Tum jidhar bhi mun kero udhar hi Allah ka mun hai, Allah Taalaa kushadgi aur wusat wala aur baray ilm wala hai
Yeh kehtay hain kay Allah Taalaa ki aulad hai, (nahi balkay)yeh) woh pak hai zamin o aasman ki tamam makhlooq uss ki milkiyat mein hai aur her aik uss farmanbardar hai
Woh zamin aur aasmano ka ibtida’an peda kerney wala hai, woh jiss kaam ko kerna chahaye keh deta hai kay hoja, bus woh o hain hojata hai

Ussi tarah bey ilm logon ney bhi kaha kay khud Allah Taalaa hum say baaten kiyon nahi kerta, ya humaray pass koi nishani kiyon nahi aati? Ussi tarah aisi hi baat unn kay aglon ney bhi kahi thi, unn kay aur unn kay dil yaksan hogaye hum ney to yaqeen walon kay liye nishaniyan biyan ker den
Hum ney aap ko haq kay sath khushkhabri denay wala aur daraney wala bana ker bheja hai aur jahannumiyon kay baray mein aap say pursish nahi hogi

Aap say yahud o nasaara hergiz razi nahi hun gay jab tak kay aap unn kay mazhab kay tabey na bann jayen, aap keh dijiye kay Allah ki hidayat hi hidayat hai aur agar aap ney bawajood apney pass ilm aajaney kay, phir unn ki khuwaishon ki pairwee ki to Allah kay pass aap ka na to koi o li hoga aur na madadgar
Jinhen hum ney kitab di hai aur woh ussay parhney kay haq kay sath parhtay hain, woh uss kitab per bhi eman rakhtay hain aur jo uss kay sath kufur keray woh nuksan wala hai
Aey aulad Yaqoob! mein ney jo nematen tum per inam ki hain unhen yaad kero aur mein ney to tumhen tamam jahano per fazilat dey rakhi thi
Uss din say daro jiss din koi nafs kissi nafs ko kuch faeedah na phoncha sakay ga, na kissi shakhs say koi fidya qabool kiya jaye ga, na ussay koi shifaat nafa dey gi, na unn ki madad ki jaye gi

Jab Ibrahim) alaihi as-salam (ko unn kay rab ney kaee kaee baaton say aazmaya aur unhon ney sab ko poora kerdiya to Allah ney farmaya kay mein tumhen logon ka imam bana doon ga, arz kerney lagay: aur meri aulad ko, farmaya mera wada zalimon say nahi

Hum ney bait Allah ko logon kay liye sawab aur aman mein ki jagah banaee, tum muqam Ibrahim ko jaye namaz muqarrar kerlo, hum ney Ibrahim) alaihi as-salam (aur Ismail) alaihi as-salam (say wada liya kay tum meray ghar ko tawaf kerney walon aur aeytikaaf kerney walon aur rukoo sajdah kerney walon kay liye pak saaf rakho

Jab Ibrahim ney kaha, aey perwerdigar! to uss jagah ko aman wala shehar bana aur yahan kay bashindon ko jo Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhney walay hun, phalon ki roziyan dey Allah Taalaa ney farmaya: mein kafiron ko bhi thora faeedah doon ga, phir unhen aag kay azab ki taraf bus kerdoon ga, yeh phonchney ki jagah buri hai

Ibrahim) alaihi as-salam (aur Ismail) alaihi as-salam (kaaba ki bunyaden aur deewaren uthatay jatay thay aur kehtay jarahey thay kay humaray perwerdigar! to hum say qabool farma, to hi sunnay wala aur jannay wala hai

Aey humaray rab! humen apna farmanbardar bana ley aur humari aulad mein say bhi aik jamat ko apni ita’at guzaar rakh aur humen apni ibadaten sikha aur humari tauba qabool farma, to tauba qabool farmaney wala aur reham o karam kerney wala hai
Aey humaray rab! unn mein unhi mein say rasool bhej jo unn kay pass teri aayaten parhay, unhen kitab o hikmat sikhaye aur unhen pak keray, yaqeenan to ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai
Deen deen-e-ibrahim say o hi raghabti keray ga jo mehaz waqoof ho, hum ney to ussay duniya mein bhi bargazeedah kiya tha aur aakhirat mein bhi woh kaaron mein say hai
Jab kabhi bhi unhen unn kay rab ney kaha, farmanbardar hoja, unhon ney kaha, mein ney rab aalameen ki farmanbardari ki
Ussi ki wasiyat Ibrahim aur Yaqoob ney apni aulad ki, kay humaray bacho! Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye uss deen ko pasand farma hai, khabardaar! tum musalman hi marna

Kiya (hazrat) Yaqoob kay intiqal kay waqt tum mojood thay? Jab unhon ney apni aulad ko kaha kay meray baad tum kiss ki ibadat kero gay? To sab ney jawab diya kay aap kay mabood ki aur aap kay aaba-o-ajdaad ibrahim) alaihi as-salam (aur Ismail) alaihi as-salam (aur Ishaq) alaihi as-salam (kay mabood ki jo mabood aik hi hai aur hum ussi kay farmanbardar rahen gay
Yeh jamat to guzar chuki, jo unhon ney kiya woh unn kay liye hai aur jo tum kero gay tumharay liye hai. Unn kay aemaal kay baray mein tum nahi poochay jao gay
Yeh kehtay hain kay yahud o nasaara bann jao to hidayat pao gay. Tum kaho balkay)yeh sahih raah per millat deen-e-ibrahim walay hain, aur Ibrahim khalis Allah kay paristaar thay aur mushrik na thay

Aey musalmano! tum sab kaho kay hum Allah per eman laye aur uss cheez per bhi jo humari taraf utari gaee aur jo cheez Ibrahim Ismail Ishaq Yaqoob (alaihim as-salam) aur unn ki aulad per utari gaee aur jo kuch Allah ki janib say Musa aur Isa (alaihima as-salam) aur doosray anbiya (alaihim as-salam) diye gaye. Hum unn mein say kissi kay darmiyan farq nahi kertay, hum Allah kay farmanbardar hain
Agar woh tum jaisa eman layen to hidayat payen, aur agar mun moren to woh sareeh ikhtilaf mein hain, Allah Taalaa unn say unqareeb aap ki kifayat keray ga aur woh khoob sunnay aur jannay wala hai
Allah ka rang ikhtiyar kero aur Allah Taalaa say acha rang kiss ka hoga? Hum to ussi ki ibadat kerney walay hain
Aap keh dijiye kiya tum hum say Allah kay baray mein jhagartay ho jo humara aur tumhara rab hai, humaray liye humaray aemaal hain aur tumharay liye tumharay aemaal, hum to ussi kay liye mukhlis hain

Kiya tum kehtay ho kay Ibrahim aur Ismail aur Ishaq aur Yaqoob (alaihim as-salam) aur unn ki aulad yahudi ya nasrani thay? Keh do kay kiya tum ziyadah jantay ho, ya Allah Taalaa? Allah kay pass shahdat chupney walay say ziyadah zalim aur kaun hai? Aur Allah tumharay kaamon say ghafil nahi
Yeh ummat hai jo guzar, jo unhon ney kiya unn kay liye hai aur jo tum ney kiya tumharay liye, tum unn aemaal kay baray mein sawal na kiye jao gay

Unqareeb nadan log kahen gay kay jiss qiblay per yeh thay uss say unhen kiss cheez ney hataya? Aap keh dijiye kay mashriq maghrib ka malik Allah Taalaa hi hai woh jissay chahaye seedhi raah ki hidayat kerdey

Hum ney ussi tarah tumhen aadil ummat banaya hai takay tum logon per gawah hojao aur rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) tum per gawah hojayen, jiss qiblay per tum pehlay say thay ussay hum ney sirf uss liye muqarrar kiya tha kay hum jaan len kay rasool ka sacha tabeydaar kaun hai aur kaun hai jo apni aeriyon kay bal palat jata hai go yeh kaam mushkil hai, magar jinhen Allah ney hidayat di hai (unn per koi mushkil nahi) Allah Taalaa tumharay eman zaya na keray ga Allah Taalaa logon kay sath shafqat aur meharbani kerney wala hai

Hum aap kay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain, abb hum aap ko uss qiblay ki janib mutawajha keren gay jiss say aap khush hojayen, aap apna mun masjid haram ki taraf pher len aur aap jahan kahen hun apna mun ussi taraf phera keren. Ahl kitab ko uss baat kay Allah ki taraf say bar-haq honey ka qataee ilm hai aur Allah Taalaa unn aemaal say ghafil nahi jo yeh kertay hain

Aur aap agarcheh ahl kitab ko tamam daleelen dey den lekin woh aap kay qiblay ki pairwee nahi keren gay aur na aap unn kay qiblay ko mannay walay hain aur na yeh aapas mein aik doosray kay qiblay ko mannay walay hain aur agar aap bawajood aap kay pass ilm chuka phir bhi unn ki khuwaishon kay peechay lag jayen to bil-yaqeen aap bhi zalimon mein say hojayen gay
Jinhen hum ney kitab di hai woh to ussay aisa pehchantay hain jaisay koi apney bachon ko pehchaney, unn ki aik jamat haq ko pehchan ker phir chupati hai
Aap kay rab ki taraf say yeh sirasir haq hai, khabardaar aap shak kerney walon mein say na hona
Her shakhs aik na aik taraf mutawajha ho raha hai tum nekiyon ki taraf doro. Jahan kahen bhi tum hogay, Allah tumhen ley aaye ga. Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Aap jahan say niklen apna mun (namaz kay liye) masjid haram ki taraf kerliya keren, yehi haq hai aap kay rab ki taraf say, jo kuch tum ker rahey ho uss say Allah Taalaa bey-khabar nahi

Aur jiss jagah say aap niklen apna mun masjid haram ki taraf pher len aur jahan kahen tum ho apney chehray ussi taraf kiya kero takay logon ki koi hujjat tum per baqi na reh jaye siwaye unn logon kay jinhon ney unn mein say zulm kiya hai tum unn say na daro mujh hi say daro aur takay mein apni nemat tum per poori keroon aur uss liye bhi kay tum raah raast pao

Jiss tarah hum ney tum mein tumhin mein say rasool bheja jo humari aayaten tumharay samney tilawat kerta hai aur tumhen pak kerta hai aur tumhen kitab o hikmat aur woh cheezen sikhata hai jin say tum be-ilm thay
Uss liye tum mera zikar kero, mein bhi tumhen yaad keroon ga, meri shukar guzari kero aur na-shukri say bacho
Aey eman walo! sabar aur namaz kay zariye madad chahao, Allah Taalaa sabar walon ka sath deta hai
Aur Allah Taalaa ki raah kay shaheedon ko murdah mat kaho woh zindah hain, lekin tum nahi samajhtay
Aur hum kissi na kissi tarah tumhari aazmaeesh zaroor keren gay, dushman kay darr say, bhook piyas say, maal o jaan aur phalon ki kami say aur unn sabar kerney walon ko khushkhabri dey dijiye
Jinhen, jab kabhi koi museebat aati hai to keh diya kertay hain kay hum to khud Allah Taalaa ki milkiyat hain aur hum ussi ki taraf lotney walay hain
Unn per unn kay rab ki nawazishen aur rehmaten hain aur yehi log hidayat yafta hain

Safa marwa Allah Taalaa ki nishaniyon mein say hain, uss liye bait Allah ka hajj umrah kerney walay per unn ka tawaf ker leney mein bhi koi gunah nahi apni khushi say bhalaee kerney walon ka Allah qadardaan hai aur unhen khoob jannay wala hai

Jo log humari utari hui daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain bawajood hum ussay apni kitab mein logon kay liye biyan ker chukay hain, unn logon per Allah ki aur tamam laanat kerney walon ki laanat hai
Magar woh log jo tauba kerlen aur islaah kerlen aur biyan ker den, to mein unn ki tauba qabool ker leta hun aur mein tauba qabool kerney wala aur reham o karam kerney wala hun
Yaqeenan jo kuffaar apney kufur mein hi mar jayen, unn per Allah Taalaa ki, farishton ki aur tamam logon ki laanat hai
Jiss mein yeh hamesha rahen gay, na unn say azab halka kiya jaye ga aur na unhen dheel di jaye gi
Tum sab ka mabood aik hi mabood hai, uss kay siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi woh boht reham kerney wala aur bara meharban hai

Aasmano aur zamin ki pedaeesh, raat din ka hair pher, kashtiyon ka logon ko nafa denay wali cheezon ko liye huye samandaron mein chalna, aasman say pani utaar ker, murdah zamin ko zindah ker dena, uss mein her qasam kay janwaron ko phela dena, hawaon kay rukh badalna, aur badal, jo aasman aur zamin kay darmiyan musakhar hain, unn mein aqalmandon kay liye qudrat elahi ki nishaniyan hain

Baaz log aisay bhi hain jo Allah kay shareek auron ko thehra ker unn say aisi mohabbat rakhtay hain, jaisi mohabbat Allah say honi chahaye aur eman walay Allah ki mohabbat mein boht sakht hotay hain kaash kay mushrik log jantay jab kay Allah kay azab ko dekh ker (jaan len gay) kay tamam taqat Allah hi ko hai aur Allah Taalaa sakht azab denay wala hai (to hergiz shirk na kertay)
Jiss waqt paishwa log apney tabeydaron say beyzaar hojayen gay aur azab ko apni aankhon say dekh len gay aur kul rishtay naatay toot jayen gay

Aur tabeydaar log kehney lagen gay, kaash hum duniya ki taraf doobara jayen to hum bhi unn say aisay hi beyzaar hojayen jaisay yeh hum say hain, ussi tarah Allah Taalaa unhen unn kay aemaal dikhaye ga unn ko hasrat dilaney ko, yeh hergiz jahannum say na niklen gay
Logo! zamin mein jitni bhi halal aur pakeezah cheezen hain unhen khao piyo aur shetani raah per na chalo, woh tumhara khulla hua dushman hai
Woh tumhen sirf buraee aur bey-hayai ka aur Allah Taalaa per unn baaton kay kehney ka hukum deta hai jin ka tumhen ilm nahi

Aur unn say jab kabhi kaha jata hai kay Allah Taalaa ki utari hui kitab ki tabeydaari kero to jawab detay hain kay hum to uss tareeqay ki pairwee keren gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya, go unn kay baap daday aqal aur gumm kerdah raah hun
Kuffaar ki misal unn janwaron ki tarah hai jo apney charwahey ki sirf pukar aur awaz hi ko suntay hain (samajhtay nahi) woh behray, goongay aur andhay hain, unhen aqal nahi
Aey eman walo! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen dey rakhi hain unhen khao, piyo aur Allah Taalaa ka shukar kero, agar tum khaas ussi ki ibadat kertay ho

Tum per murdah aur (baha hua) khoon aur sooar ka gosht aur her woh cheez jiss per Allah kay siwa doosron ka naam pukara gaya ho haram hai phir jo majboor hojaye aur woh hadd say barhney wala aur ziyadti kerney wala na ho, uss per unn kay khaney mein koi gunah nahi, Allah Taalaa bakhsish kerney wala meharban hai

Bey shak jo log Allah Taalaa ki utari hui kitab chupatay hain aur ussay thori thori si qeemat per baichtay hain, yaqeen mano kay yeh apney pet mein aag bhar rahey hain, qayamat kay din Allah Taalaa unn say baat bhi na keray ga, na unhen pak keray ga, balkay)yeh unn kay liye dard-naak azab hai
Yeh woh log hain jinhon ney gumrahi ko hidayat kay badlay aur azab ko maghfirat kay badlay khareed liya hai, yeh log aag ka azab kitan bardasht kerney walay hain
Unn azabon ka baees yehi hai kay Allah Taalaa ney sachi kitab utari aur uss kitab mein ikhtilaf kerney walay yaqeenan door kay khilaf mein hain

Sari achai mashriq maghrib ki taraf mun kerney mein hi nahi balkay)yeh haqeeqatan acha woh shakhs hai jo Allah Taalaa per, qayamat kay din per, farishton per, kitab Allah per aur nabiyon per eman rakhney wala ho, jo maal say mohabbat kerney kay bawajood qarabat daron, yateemon, miskeenon, musafiron aur sawal kerney walay ko dey, ghulamon ko aazad keray, namaz ki pabandi aur zakat ki adaayegi keray, jab wada keray tab ussay poora keray, tangdast, dukh dard aur laraee kay waqt sabar keray, yehi sachay log hain aur yehi perhezgar hain

Aey eman walo! tum per maqtoolon ka qisass lena farz kiya gaya hai, aazad aazad kay badlay, ghulam ghulam kay badlay, aurat aurat kay badlay. Haan jiss kissi ko uss kay bhai ki taraf say kuch moafi dey di jaye ussay bhalaee ki ittabaa kerni chahaiye aur aasani kay sath deeyat ada kerni chahaiye. Tumharay rab ki taraf say yeh takhfeef aur rehmat hai uss kay baad bhi jo sirkashi keray ussay dard naak azab hoga
Mando! qisass mein tumharay liye zindagi hai uss baees tum (qatal na-haq say) ruko gay

Tum per farz ker diya gaya hai kay jab tum mein say koi marney lagay aur maal chor jata ho to apney maa baap aur qarabat daron kay liye achai kay sath wasiyat ker, perhezgaron per yeh haq aur sabit hai
Abb jo shakhs ussay sunnay kay baad badal dey uss ka gunah badalney walay per hi hoga, waqaee Allah Taalaa sunnay wala jannay wala hai
Haan jo shakhs wasiyat kerney walay ki janib daari ya gunah ki wasiyat kerdenay say daray pus woh unn mein aapas mein islaah kera to uss per gunah nahi, Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai
Aey eman walo! tum per rozay rakhna farz kiya gaya jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon per farz kiye gaye thay, takay tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero

Ginti kay chand hi din hain lekin tum mein say jo shakhs beemar ho ya safar mein ho to woh aur dino mein ginti ko poora ker ley aur uss ki taqat rakhney walay fidya mein aik miskeen ko khana den, phir jo shakhs neki mein sabqat keray woh ussi kay liye behtar hai lekin tumharay haq mein behtar kaam rozay rakhna hi hai agar tum ba-ilm ho

Mah maah-e-ramzan woh hai jiss mein Quran utara gaya jo logon ko hidayat kerney wala hai aur jiss mein hidayat ki aur haq o baatil ki tameez ki nishaniyan hain, tum mein say jo shakhs uss maheeney ko paye ussay roza rakhna chahaiye, haan jo beemar ho ya musafir ho ussay doosray dino mein yeh ginti poori kerni chahaiye, Allah Taalaa ka iradah tumharay sath aasani ka hai, sakhti ka nahi, woh chahata hai kay tum ginti poori kerlo aur Allah Taalaa ki di hui hidayat per uss ki baraiyan biyan kero aur uss ka shukar kero

Jab meray banday meray baray mein aap say sawal keren to aap keh den kay mein boht hi qareeb hun her pukarney walay ki pukar ko jab kabhi woh mujhay pukaray, qabool kerta hun uss liye logon ko bhi chahaiye kay woh meri baat maan liya keren aur mujh per eman rakhen, yehi unn ki bhalaee ka baees hai

Rozay ki raaton mein apni biwiyon say milna tumharay liye halal kiya gaya, woh tumhara libas hain aur tum unn kay libas ho, tumhari posheedah khayanaton ka Allah Taalaa ko ilm hai, uss ney tumhari tauba qabool farma ker tum say darguzar farma, abb tumhen unn say mubashirat ki aur Allah Taalaa ki likhi hui cheez ko talash kerney ki ijazat hai, tum khatay peetay raho yahan tak kay subha ka safaid dhaga siyah dhagay say zahir hojaye. Phir raat tak rozay ko poora kero aur aurton say uss waqt mubashirat na kero jab kay tum masjidon mein aeytikaaf mein ho. Yeh Allah Taalaa ki hudood hain, tum unn kay qareeb bhi na jao. Ussi tarah Allah Taalaa apni aayaten logon kay liye biyan farmata hai takay woh bachen
Aur aik doosray ka maal na-haq na khaya kero, na hakimon ko rishwat phoncha ker kissi ka kuch maal zulm o sitam say apna ker liya kero, halankay tum jantay ho

Log aap say chand kay baray mein sawal kertay hain aap keh dijiye kay yeh logon (ki ibadat) kay waqton aur hajj kay mausam kay liye hai (ehraam ki halat mein) aur gharon kay peechay say tumhara aana kuch neki nahi, balkay)yeh neki wala woh hai jo muttaqi ho. Aur gharon mein to darwazon mein say aaya kero aur Allah say dartay raho, takay tum kaamyaab hojao
Laro Allah ki raah mein unn say jo tum say lartay hain aur ziyadti na kero, Allah Taalaa ziyadti kerney walon ko pasand nahi farmata

Unhen maaro jahan bhi pao aur unhen nikalo jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala hai aur (suno) fitna qatal say ziyadah sakht hai aur masjid haram kay pass unn say laraee na kero jab tak kay yeh khud tum say na laren, agar yeh tum say laren to tum bhi unhen maaro kafiron ka badla yehi hai
Agar yeh baaz aajayen to Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai
Unn say laro jab tak kay fitna na mitt jaye aur Allah Taalaa ka deen ghalib na aajaye, agar yeh ruk jayen (to tum bhi ruk jao) ziyadti to sirf zalimon per hi hai

Hurmat walay maheeney hurmat walay maheenon kay badlay hain aur hurmaten adlay badlay ki hain jo tum per ziyadti keray tum bhi uss per ussi kay misil ziyadti kero jo tum per ki hai aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raha kero aur jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa perhezgaron kay sath hai
Allah Taalaa ki raah mein kharach kero aur apney hathon halakat mein na paro aur salook o ehsan kero, Allah Taalaa ehsan kerney walon ko dost rakhta hai

Hajj aur umray ko Allah Taalaa kay liye poora kero, haan agar tum rok liye jao to jo qurbani mayassar ho, ussay ker dalo aur apney sir na mundwao jab tak kay qurbani qurban gaah tak na phonch jaye albatta tum mein say jo beemar ho, ya uss kay sir mein koi takleef ho (jiss ki wajah say sir munda) to uss per fidya hai, khuwah rozay rakh ley, khuwah sadqa dey dey, khuwah qurbani keray pus jab tum aman ki halat mein hojao to jo shakhs umray say ley ker hajj tak tamatto keray, pus ussay jo qurbani mayassar ho ussay ker dalay, jissay taqat hi na ho woh teen rozay to hajj kay dino mein rakh ley aur saat wapsi mein, yeh pooray das hogaye. Yeh hukum unn kay liye hai jo masjid haram kay rehney walay na hun, logo! Allah say dartay raho aur jaan lo kay Allah Taalaa sakht azab wala hai

Hajj kay maheeney muqarrar hain uss liye jo shakhs unn mein hajj lazim kerley woh apni biwi say mail milaap kerney, gunah kerney aur laraee jhagray kerney say bachta rahey, tum jo neki kero gay uss say Allah Taalaa ba-khabar hai aur apney sath safar kharach ley liya kero, sab say behtar tosha Allah Taalaa ka darr hai aur aey mando! mujh say dartay raha kero

Tum per apney rab ka fazal talash kerney mein koi gunah nahi jab tum arfaat say loto to mash'ar haram kay pass zikar elahi kero aur uss ka zikar kero jaisay kay uss ney tumhen hidayat di, halankay tum uss say pehlay raah bhoolay huye thay
Phir tum uss jagah say loto jiss jagah say sab log lottay hain aur Allah Taalaa say talab bakhsish kertay raho yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai

Phir jab tum arkaan-e-hajj hajj ada ker chuko to Allah Taalaa ka zikar kero jiss tarah tum apney baap dadon ka zikar kiya kertay thay, balkay)yeh uss say bhi ziyadah baaz log woh bhi hain jo kehtay hain aey humaray rab! humen duniya mein dey. Aisay logon ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi
Aur baaz log woh bhi hain jo kehtay hain aey humaray rab! humen duniya mein neki dey aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaee ata farma aur humen azab jahannum say nijat dey
Yeh woh log hain jin kay liye unn kay aemaal ka hissa hai aur Allah Taalaa jald hisab lenay wala hai

Aur Allah Taalaa ki yaad unn ginti kay chand dino (ayyam ayyaam-e-tashreeq) mein kero, do din ki jaldi kerney walay per bhi koi gunah nahi, aur jo peechay reh jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi, yeh perhezgar liye hai aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho aur jaan rakho kay tum sab ussi ki taraf jama kiye jao gay
Baaz logon ki dunyawi gharz ki baaten aap ko khush ker deti hain aur woh apney dil ki baaton per Allah ko gawah kerta hai, halankay dar-asal woh zabardast jhagraloo hai
Jab woh lot ker jata hai to zamin mein fasad phelaney ki aur kheti aur nasal ki barbadi ki koshish mein laga rehta hai aur Allah Taalaa fasad ko pasand kerta hai
Aur jab uss say kaha jaye kay Allah say darr to takabbur aur ta’assub ussay gunah per aamaadah ker deta hai, aisay kay liye bus jahannum hi hai aur yaqeenan woh bad tareen jagah hai
Aur baaz log woh bhi hain kay Allah Taalaa ki razamandi ki talab mein apni jaan tak baich daaltay hain aur Allah Taalaa apney bandon per bari meharbani kerney wala hai
Eman walo! islam mein pooray pooray dakhil hojao aur shetan kay qadmon ki tabeydaari na kero woh tumhara khulla dushman hai
Agar tum bawajood tumharay pass daleelen aajaney kay bhi phisal jao to jaan lo kay Allah Taalaa ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai

Kiya logon ko uss baat ka intizar hai kay unn kay pass khud Allah Taalaa abar kay sayebanon mein aajaye aur farishtay bhi aur kaam inteha tak phoncha diya jaye, Allah hi ki taraf tamam kaam lotaye jatay hain

Bani israeel say poocho to kay hum ney unhen kiss qadar roshan nishaniyan ata farmaeen aur jo shakhs Allah Taalaa ki nematon ko apney pass phonch janey kay baad badal dalay (woh jaan ley) kay Allah Taalaa bhi sakht azabon wala hai

Kafiron kay liye duniya ki zindagi khoob zeenat daar ki gaee hai, woh eman walon say hansi mazaq kertay hain, halankay perhezgar log qayamat kay din unn say aala hun gay, Allah Taalaa jissay chahata hai hisab rozi deta hai

Dar-asal log aik hi giroh thay Allah Taalaa ney nabiyon ko khushkhabriyan denay aur daraney wala bana ker bheja aur unn kay sath sachi kitaben nazil farmaeen, takay logon kay her ikhtilafi amar ka faisla hojaye. Aur sirf unn hi logon ney jinhen kitab di gaee thi, apney pass dalaeel chukney kay baad aapas kay bughz o inaad ki wajah say uss mein ikhtilaf kiya uss liye Allah pak ney eman walon ki uss ikhtilaf mein bhi haq ki taraf apni mashiyat say rehbari ki aur Allah jiss ko chahaye seedhi raah ki taraf rehbari kerta hai

Kiya tum yeh guman kiye bethay ho kay jannat mein chalay jao gay, halankay abb tak tum per woh halaat nahi aaye jo tum say aglay logon per aaye thay. Unhen beemariyan aur musibaten phonchin aur woh yahan tak jhanjoray gaye kay rasool aur uss kay sath kay eman walay kehney lagay kay Allah ki madad kab aaye gi? Sunn rakho kay Allah ki madad qareeb hi hai

Aap say poochtay hain kay woh kiya kharach keren? Aap keh dijiye jo maal tum kharach kero woh maa baap kay liye hai aur rishtedaron aur yateemon aur miskeenon aur musafiron kay liye hai aur tum jo kuch bhalaee kero gay Allah Taalaa ko uss ka ilm hai

Tum per jihad farz kiya gaya go woh tumhen dushwar maloom ho, mumkin hai kay tum kissi cheez ko buri jano aur dar-asal o hi tumharay liye bhali ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai kay tum kissi cheez ko achi samjho, halankay woh tumharay liye buri ho, haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai, tum mehaz bey-khabar ho

Log aap say hurmat walay maheenon mein laraee ki babat sawal kertay hain, aap keh dijiye kay unn mein laraee kerna bara gunah hai, lekin Allah ki raah say rokna, uss kay sath kufur kerna aur masjid haram say rokna aur o haan kay rehney walon ko o haan say nikalna, Allah kay nazdeek uss say bhi bara gunah hai yeh fitna qatal say bhi bara gunah hai, yeh log tum say laraee bhiraee kertay hi rahen gay yahan tak kay agar unn say hosakay to tumhen tumharay deen say murtid ker den aur tum mein say jo log apney deen say palat jayen aur ussi kufur ki halat mein maren, unn kay aemaal dunyawi aur ukhrawi sab ghaarat hojayen gay. Yeh log jahannumi hun gay aur hamesha hamesha jahannum mein hi rahen gay
Albatta eman laney walay, hijrat kerney walay, Allah ki raah mein jihad kerney walay hi rehmat elahi kay umeedwaar hain, Allah Taalaa boht bakhshney wala aur boht meharbani kerney wala hai

Log aap say sharab aur juye ka masla poochtay hain, aap keh dijiye unn dono mein boht bara gunah hai aur logon ko uss say dunyawi faeedah bhi hota hai, lekin unn ka gunah unn kay nafa say boht ziyadah hai. Aap say yeh bhi daryaft kertay hain kay kiya kuch kharach keren? To aap keh dijiye hajat say zaeed cheez, Allah Taalaa ussi tarah apney ehkaam saaf saaf tumharay liye biyan farma raha hai, takay tum soch samajh sako,

Duniya aur aakhirat kay umoor ko. Aur tujh say yateemon kay baray mein bhi sawal kertay hain aap keh dijiye kay unn ki khair-khuwahi behtar hai, tum agar unn ka maal apney maal mein mila bhi lo to woh tumharay bhai hain, bad-niyat aur nek niyat her aik ko Allah khoob janta hai aur agar Allah chahata to tumhen mushaqqat mein daal deta, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai

Aur shirk kerney wali aurton say ta-waqt-e-kay woh eman na layen tum nikkah na kero, eman wali londi bhi shirk kerney wali aazad aurat say boht behtar hai, go tumhen mushrika hi achi lagti ho aur na shirk kerney walay mardon kay nikkah mein apni aurton ko do jab tak kay woh eman na layen, eman wala ghulam aazad mushrik say behtar hai, go mushrik tumhen acha lagay. Yeh log jahannum ki taraf bulatay hain aur Allah jannat ki taraf aur apni bakhsish ki taraf apney hukum say bulata hai, woh apni aayaten logon kay liye biyan farma raha hai, takay woh naseehat hasil keren

Aap say haiz kay baray mein sawal kertay hain, keh dijiye kay woh gandagi hai, halat haiz mein aurton say alag raho aur jab tak woh pak na hojayen unn kay qareeb na jao, haan jab woh pak hojayen to unn kay pass jao jahan say Allah ney tumhen ijazat di hai, Allah tauba kerney walon ko aur pak rehney walon ko pasand farmata hai

Tumhari biwiyan tumhari khetiyan hain, apni khetiyon mein jiss tarah chahao aao aur apney liye (nek aemaal) aagay bhejo aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raha kero aur jaan rakho kay tum uss say milney walay ho aur eman walon ko khush khabri suna dijiye
Aur Allah Taalaa ko apni qasmon ka (uss tarah) nishana na banao kay bhalaee aur perhezgari aur logon kay darmiyan ki islaah ko chor betho aur Allah Taalaa sunnay wala jannay wala hai
Allah Taalaa tumhen tumhari unn qasmon per na pakray ga jo pukhta na hun haan uss ki pakar uss cheez per hai jo tumharay dilon ka fail ho, Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala aur burdbaar hai
Jo log apni biwiyon say (talluq na rakhney ki) qasmen khayen, unn kay liye char maheeney ki muddat hai, phir agar woh lot aayen to Allah Taalaa bhi bakhshney wala meharban hai
Aur agar tallaq ka hi qasad kerlen to Allah Taalaa sunnay wala, jannay wala hai

Tallaq wali aurten apney aap ko teen haiz tak rokay rakhen, unhen halal nahi kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo peda kiya ho ussay chupayen, agar unhen Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman ho, unn kay khawind uss muddat mein unhen lota lenay kay pooray haqdaar hain agar unn ka iradah islaah ka ho. Aur aurton kay bhi wesay hi haq hain jaisay unn per mardon kay hain achai kay sath. Haan mardon ko aurton per fazeelat hai aur Allah Taalaa ghalib hai hikmat wala hai

Yeh tallaqen do martaba hain, phir ya to achai say rokna ya umdagi kay sath chor dena hai aur tumhen halal nahi kay tum ney unhen jo dey diya hai uss mein say kuch bhi lo, haan yeh aur baat hai kay dono ko Allah ki hadden qaeem na rakh sakney ka khof ho, uss liye agar tumhen darr ho kay yeh dono Allah ki hadden qaeem na rakh saken gay to aurat rehaee paney kay liye kuch dey dalay, uss mein dono per gunah nahi yeh Allah ki hudood hain khabardaar unn say aagay na barhna aur jo log Allah ki haddon say tajawuz ker jayen woh zalim hain

Phir agar uss ko (teesri baar) tallaq dey dey to abb uss kay liye halal nahi jab tak woh aurat uss kay siwa doosray say nikkah na keray, phir agar woh bhi tallaq dey dey to unn dono ko mail jol ker leney mein koi gunah nahi ba-shart-e-kay yeh jaan len kay Allah ki haddon ko qaeem rakh saken gay, yeh Allah Taalaa ki hudood hain jinhen woh jannay walon kay liye biyan farma raha hai.

Jab tum aurton ko tallaq do aur woh apni iddat khatam kerney per aayen to abb unhen achi tarah basao, ya bhalaee kay sath alag kerdo aur unhen takleef phonchaney ki gharz say zulm o ziyadti kay liye na roko, jo shakhs aisa keray uss ney apni jaan per zulm kiya. Tum Allah kay ehkaam ko hansi khel na banao aur Allah ka ehsan jo tum per hai yaad kero aur jo kuch kitab o hikmat uss ney nazil farmaee hai jiss say tumhen naseehat ker raha hai, ussay bhi. Aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raha kero aur jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa her cheez ko janta hai

Aur jab tum apni aurton ko tallaq do aur woh apni iddat poori kerlen to unhen unn kay khawindon say nikkah kerney say na roko jab kay woh aapas mein dastoor kay mutabiq mand hun. Yeh naseehat unhen ki jati hai jinhen tum mein say Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per yaqeen o eman ho, uss mein tumhari behtareen safaee aur pakeezgi hai. Allah Taalaa janta hai aur tum nahi jantay

Maayen apni aulad ko do saal kamil doodh pilayen jin ka iradah doodh pilaney ki muddat bilkul poori kerney ka ho aur jin kay bachay hain unn kay zimmay unn ka roti kapra hai jo mutabiq dastoor kay ho. Her shakhs itni hi takleef diya jata hai jitni uss ki taqat ho. Maa ko uss kay bacha ki wajah say ya baap ko uss ki aulad wajah say koi zarar na phonchaya jaye. Waris per bhi ussi jaisi zimmay daari hai, phir agar dono (yani maa baap) apni razamandi aur bahumi mashwaray say doodh churana chahayen to dono per kuch gunah nahi aur agar tumhara iradah apni aulad ko doodh pilwaney ka ho to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi jab kay tum unn ko mutabiq dastoor kay jo dena ho woh unn kay hawalay kerdo, Allah Taalaa say dartay raho aur jantay raho kay Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal ki dekh bhaal ker raha hai

Tum mein say jo log fot hojayen aur biwiyan chor jayen, woh aurten apney aap ko char maheeney aur das (din) iddat mein rakhen, phir jab muddat khatam kerlen to jo achai kay sath woh apney liye keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi aur Allah Taalaa tumharay her amal say khabardaar hai

Tum per uss mein koi gunah nahi kay tum isharatan kanayatan unn aurton say nikkah ki babat kaho, ya apney dil mein posheedah iradah kero, Allah Taalaa ko ilm hai kay tum zaroor unn ko yaad kero gay, lekin tum unn say posheedah waday na kerlo haan yeh aur baat hai kay tum bhali baat bola kero aur aqad nikkah jab tak kay iddat khatam na hojaye pukhta na kero, jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa ko tumharay dilon ki baaton ka bhi ilm hai, tum uss say khof khatay raha kero aur yeh bhi jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa bakhsish aur ilm wala hai

Agar tum aurton ko baghair hath lagaye aur baghair mehar muqarrar kiye tallaq dey do to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi, haan unhen kuch na kuch faeedah do. Khushal apney andaz say aur tangdast apni taqat kay mutabiq dastoor kay mutabiq acha faeedah dey. Bhalaee kerney walon per yeh lazim hai

Aur agar tum aurton ko uss say pehlay tallaq dey do kay tum ney unhen hath lagaya ho aur tum ney unn ka mehar bhi muqarrar kerdiya ho to muqarrara mehar ka aadha mehar dey do, yeh aur baat hai kay woh khud moaf ker den ya woh shakhs moaf kerdey jiss kay hath mein nikkah ki girah hai tumhara moaf ker dena taqwa say boht nazdeek hai aur aapas ki fazilat aur buzrugi ko faramosh na kero, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal ko dekh raha hai
Namazon ki hifazat kero, bilkhusoos darmiyan wali namaz ki aur Allah Taalaa kay liye adab kharay raha kero
Agar tumhen khof ho to paidal hi sahi ya sawar hi sahi, haan jab aman hojaye to Allah ka zikar kero jiss tarah kay uss ney tumhen uss baat ki taleem di jissay tum nahi jantay thay

Jo log tum mein say fot hojayen aur biwiyan chor jayen woh wasiyat ker jayen kay unn ki biwiyan saal bhar tak faeedah uthayen unhen koi na nikalay, haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to tum per uss mein koi gunah nahi jo woh apney liye achai say keren, Allah Taalaa ghalib aur hakeem hai
Tallaq waliyon ko achi tarah faeedah dena perhezgaron per lazim hai
Allah Taalaa ussi tarah apni aayaten tum per zahir farma raha hai takay tum samjho

Kiya tum ney unhen nahi dekha jo hazaron ki tadaad mein thay aur maut kay darr kay maaray apney gharon say nikal kharay huye thay. Allah Taalaa ney unhen farmaya marr, phir unhen zindah kerdiya bey shak Allah Taalaa logon per bara fazal wala hai, lekin aksar log na-shukray hain
Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad kero aur jaan lo kay Allah Taalaa sunta, janta hai
Aisa bhi koi hai jo Allah Taalaa ko acha qarz dey pus Allah Taalaa ussay boht barha charha ker ata farmaye, Allah hi tangi aur kushadgi kerta hai aur tum sab ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay

Kiya aap ney (hazrat) Musa kay baad wali bani israeel ki jamat ko nahi dekha jab kay unhon ney apney payghumbar say kaha kay kissi ko humara badshah bana dijiye takay hum Allah ki raah mein jihad keren. Payghumbar ney kaha kay mumkin hai jihad farz hojaney kay baad tum jihad na kero, unhon ney kaha bhala hum Allah ki raah mein jihad kiyon na keren gay? Hum to apney gharon say ujaray gaye hain aur bachon say door kerdiye gaye hain. Phir jab unn per jihad farz hua to siwaye thoray say logon kay sab phir gaye aur Allah Taalaa zalimon ko khoob janta hai

Aur unhen unn kay nabi ney farmaya kay Allah Taalaa ney taloot ko tumhara badshah bana diya hai to kehney lagay bhala uss ki hum per hukoomat kaisay hosakti hai? Uss say to boht ziyadah haqdaar badshahat kay hum hain, uss ko to maali kushadgi bhi nahi di gaee. Nabi ney farmaya suno, Allah Taalaa ney ussi ko tum per bargazeedah kiya hai aur ussay ilmi aur jismani bartari bhi ata farmaee hai baat yeh hai kay Allah jissay chahaye apna mulk dey, Allah Taalaa kushadgi wala aur ilm wala hai

Unn kay nabi ney unhen phir kaha kay uss ki badshahat ki zahiri nishani yeh hai kay tumharay pass woh sandooq aa jaye ga jiss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say dil-jamai hai aur aal Musa aur aal Haroon ka baqiya tarkay hai, farishtay ussay utha ker layen gay. Yaqeenan yeh to tumharay liye khulli daleel hai agar tum eman walay ho

Jab (hazrat) taloot lashkaron ko ley ker niklay to kaha suno Allah Taalaa tumhen aik nehar say aazmaney wala hai, jiss ney uss mein say pani pi liya woh mera nahi aur jo ussay na chakhay woh mera hai, haan yeh aur baat hai kay apney hath say aik chalo bhar. Lekin siwaye chand kay baqi sab ney woh pani pi liya (hazrat) taloot momineen samet jab nehar say guzar gaye to woh log kehney lagay aaj to hum mein taqat nahi kay jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron say laren. Lekin Allah Taalaa ki mulaqat per yaqeen rakhney walon ney kaha, basa oqat choti aur thori si jamaten bari aur boht si jamaton per Allah kay hukum say ghalba paaleti hain, Allah Taalaa sabar walon kay sath hai
Jab unn ka jaloot aur uss kay lashkar say muqabla hua to unhon ney dua maangi kay aey perwerdigar humen sabar dey, sabit qadmi dey aur qom kuffaar per humari madad farma

Chunacha Allah Taalaa kay hukum say unhon ney jalootiyon ko shikast dey di aur (hazrat) Dawood (alaihi as-salam) kay hathon jaloot qatal hua aur Allah Taalaa ney Dawood (alaihi as-salam) ko mumlikat o hikmat aur jitna kuch chaha ilm bhi ata farmaya. Agar Allah Taalaa baaz logon ko baaz say dafa na kerta to zamin mein fasad phel jata, lekin Allah Taalaa duniya walon per bara fazal o karam kerney wala hai
Yeh Allah Taalaa ki aayaten hain jinhen hum haqqaniyat kay sath aap per parhtay hain, bil-yaqeen aap rasoolon mein say hain

Yeh rasool hain jin mein say hum ney baaz ko baaz per fazilat di hai, unn mein say baaz woh hain jin say Allah Taalaa ney baat cheet ki hai aur baaz kay darjay buland kiye hain, aur hum ney Isa bann Maryam ko mojzaat ata farmaye aur rooh rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki. Agar Allah Taalaa chahata to unn kay baad walay apney pass daleelen aajaney kay baad hergiz aapas mein laraee bhiraee na kertay, lekin unn logon ney ikhtilaf kiya, unn mein say baaz to momin huye aur baaz kafir, aur agar Allah Taalaa chahata to yeh aapas mein na lartay, lekin Allah Taalaa jo chahata hai kerta hai
Aey eman walo! jo hum ney tumhen dey rakha hai uss mein say kharach kertay raho uss say pehlay kay woh din aaye jiss mein na tijarat hai na dosti aur shifaat aur kafir hi zalim hain

Allah Taalaa hi mabood bar-haq hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo zindah aur sab ka thamney wala hai, jissay na oongh aaye na neend, uss ki milkiyat mein zamin aur aasmano ki tamam cheezen hain. Kaun hai jo uss ki ijazat kay baghair uss kay samney shifaat kersakay, woh janta hai jo unn kay samney hai aur jo unn kay peechay hai aur woh uss kay ilm mein say kissi cheez ka ehaata nahi saktay magar jitna woh chahaye, uss ki kursi ki wusat ney zamin o aasman ko gher rakha hai aur Allah Taalaa unn ki hifazat say na thakta aur na uktata hai, woh to boht buland aur boht bara hai

Deen kay baray mein koi zabardasti nahi, hidayat zalalat say roshan hochuki hai, uss liye jo shakhs Allah Taalaa kay siwa doosray maboodon ka inkar kerkay Allah Taalaa per eman laye uss ney mazboot karay ko thaam liya, jo kabhi na tootay ga aur Allah Taalaa sunnay wala, jannay wala hai

Eman laney walon ka kaarsaaz Allah Taalaa khud hai, woh unhen andheron say roshni ki taraf nikal ley jata hai aur kafiron kay auliya shayateen hain. Woh unhen roshni say nikal ker andheron ki taraf ley jatay hain, yeh log jahannumi hain jo hamesha ussi mein paray rahen gay

Kiya tu ney ussay nahi dekha jo saltanat paa ker Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) say uss kay rab kay baray mein jhagar raha tha, jab Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay mera rab to woh hai jo jilata hai aur maarta hai, woh kehney laga mein bhi jilata aur maarta hun, Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha Allah Taalaa sooraj ko mashriq ki taraf say ley aata hai to ussay maghrib ki janib say ley aa. Abb to woh kafir bhoncka reh gaya, aur Allah Taalaa zalimon ko hidayat nahi deta

Ya uss shakhs kay manind kay jiss ka guzar uss basti per hua jo chat kay bal ondhi pari hui thi, woh kehney laga uss ki maut kay baad Allah Taalaa ussay kiss tarah zindah keray ga? To Allah Taalaa ney ussay maar diya so saal kay liye, phir ussay uthaya, poocha kitni muddat tujh per guzri? Kehney laga aik din ya din ka kuch hissa, farmaya balkay)yeh to so saal tak raha, phir abb to apney khaney peenay ko dekh kay bilkul kharab nahi hua aur apney gadhay ko bhi dekh, hum tujhay logon kay liye aik nishani banatay hain to dekh kay hum haddiyon ko kiss tarah uthatay hain, phir unn per gosht charhatay hain, jab yeh sab zahir ho chuka to kehney laga mein janta hun kay Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Shetan tumhen faqeeri say dhamkata hai aur bey-hayai ka hukum deta hai, aur Allah Taalaa tum say apni bakhsish aur fazal ka wada kerta hai, Allah Taalaa wusat wala aur ilm wala hai
Woh jissay chahaye hikmat aur danaee deta hai aur jo shakhs hikmat aur samajh diya jaye woh boht sari bhalaee diya gaya aur naseehat sirf aqalmand hi hasil kertay hain
Tum jitna kuch kharach kero yani kheyraat aur jo kuch nazar mano ussay Allah Taalaa bakhoobi janta hai, aur zalimon ka koi madadgar nahi
